Aiden / team — technical notes I want to surface ahead of the call so we can keep the meeting focused: 

- KV cache warmup: plan for 5–10 minute prefix warmup for the typical prompt shapes; TTL of 30m for the staging run to avoid cache thrash.
- Model variant equivalence: we’ll serve a quantized variant (8-bit) in the fallback path. Quality diffs are minimal on the Skyline prompt set but expect a ~1–1.5% top-line metric delta (we should validate on the pre-call corpus).
- Latency delta: fallback adds ~40–80ms p99 depending on batch size and sequence length. Recommend target batch_size <= 8 during cutover to keep p99 under 250ms in staging.
- Smoke tests (pre-call dry-run):
  1) <10 reqs/s for 5 minutes with the staging prompt set
  2) Validate end-to-end trace appears in console (trace id check)
  3) Run a quick correctness sample (10 prompts) and compare embeddings/outputs to baseline

If you confirm the 21 Aug 14:00 ET slot, I propose we do a 13:00 ET dry-run (30 min) so we can warm caches and run smoke tests before the deep-dive. I’ll prepare a 1-page cutover checklist to share.

—Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
